card.name: Inside inhaler and actuator words
card.fires_on: The first piece of a long word like actuator, inhaler, inhalation or Aerosphere, in instructions for using a metered-dose inhaler. Seen most in priming and spray directions.

modes.label: Actuator
modes.description: The start of the word actuator after a brand name or in a warning about not mixing parts.
modes.example: Do not use the DULERA<< act>>uator with any other inhalation drug product

modes.label: Inhaler or inhalation
modes.description: The start of inhaler or inhalation in priming, cleaning or storage text.
modes.example: Keep the<< inhal>>er clean and dry at all times.

modes.label: Spray or aerosol names
modes.description: The start of spray or an aerosol product name in priming directions.
modes.example: To prime Levalbuterol tartrate HFA inhalation aerosol, release 4<< spr>>ays into the air away from the face

card.writes: It seems to push toward finishing device words such as valve, device and spray parts.
card.plain: It fires on the opening of inhaler-device words like actuator and inhaler in directions for using an inhaler.
